definitions.explanation: The general conditional ending, attached to the verb or adjective stem. It presents the first clause as the condition under which the second holds, and is the most neutral and abstract of the Japanese conditionals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安|やす}ければ→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: If it's cheap, I'll buy it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{手伝|てつだ}います→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
examples.english: If I have time, I'll help.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まっすぐ→まっすぐ：00866_massugu⟧⟦{行|い}けば→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}きます→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: If you go straight along this road, you'll reach the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦くれれば→くれる：00724_kureru⟧、⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: If you had consulted me sooner, I could have done something about it.

notes:
FORMS:
- Godan verb: final -u → -eba (⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ → ⟦{行|い}けば→行く：00119_iku⟧)
- Ichidan verb: -る → -れば (⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ → ⟦{食|た}べれば→食べる：00396_taberu⟧)
- I-adjective: -い → -ければ (⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ → ⟦{安|やす}ければ→安い：00464_yasui⟧)
- Noun / na-adjective: + で⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧ or なら
- Negative: -⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧ (⟦{行|い}かなければ→行く：00119_iku⟧)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜ば〜ほど: the more ~, the more ~ — ⟦{読|よ}めば→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ほど⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧
- 〜ば⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: it would be good if ~, you should ~ — ⟦{聞|き}けば→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧
- 〜ば⟦よかった→いい：00118_ii⟧: I wish I had ~ — ⟦{行|い}けば→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦よかった→いい：00118_ii⟧
- 〜⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧: must ~

CONTRAST WITH OTHER CONDITIONALS:
- ば: general, abstract condition; least tied to a specific occasion
- たら: if/when, after the first event is completed; best for one-off situations
- なら: if that is the case — responds to information just given
- ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: automatic or habitual result; the second clause cannot be a request or command

A request, command, or invitation in the second clause is awkward with ば; use たら instead.
